factor_value.evidence: inferred: 20 million NALM-6 cells were treated for 18 h with 2.5 µM TAK285 or vehicle control (DMSO, 18 h) in RPMI

number_of_biological_replicates.evidence: To test for differentially abundant proteins, ANOVA for individual proteins across all biological replicates (n = 3) was performed.

number_of_fractions.evidence: A total of 36 fractions were collected, using a previously described pooling strategy.

technology_type.evidence: The hit compound TAK285 was subjected to full proteome profiling by TMTpro 6-plex to assess its degradation selectivity in NALM-6 cells.
